summary: Parallel for Startups gives early-stage teams building on live web data credits usable across any Parallel API. Founders in YC, a16z speedrun, Neo, Entrepreneurs First, Founders Inc and Null Fellows have a program-set offer; founders who apply directly start with $250. Credits expire six months after they are issued (Founders Inc credits do not expire). The startups page headline reads '250,000 searches on us'.
claim_steps: Create a Parallel account at platform.parallel.ai and copy your org ID
Apply with the form at parallel.ai/startups, describing what you are building
YC founders redeem via Bookface Deals; a16z speedrun founders via the speedrun partner portal
